text.arabic_uthmani: قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ٱسْتُضْعِفُوٓا۟ أَنَحْنُ صَدَدْنَٰكُمْ عَنِ ٱلْهُدَىٰ بَعْدَ إِذْ جَآءَكُم ۖ بَلْ كُنتُم مُّجْرِمِينَ

words.gloss_range: reported, completed saying that opens a quoted rebuttal
words.root_gloss_range: speech and articulated claim; locally direct Form I reporting, not caused or fabricated speech
words.prose: {{ar:قَالَ}} ({{tr:qāla}}) opens the ayah as a completed speech turn before the plural speaker is fully unfolded. The singular verb-first frame lets the utterance arrive as a formal answer, then the following relative clause identifies the speakers by self-exaltation. The q-w-l field makes the answer publicly accountable speech: inner reasoning crosses the mouth-threshold into sounded testimony, becomes a transmissible claim, and remains their own direct Form I utterance rather than caused or fabricated speech. Across 34:31-32, accusation becomes counter-speech; the same saying-and-arrival pattern also prepares the later quoted reaction when truth comes (34:43).

topics.headline: reported counter-speech frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the ayah as a quoted defense inside a dispute, not as a narrator summary.
topics.reason: The perfect speech verb governs the quote and opens a formal reply before the plural conduct-label is unfolded.

topics.headline: accountable direct utterance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the arrogant group is evaluated through words it releases as a public claim, while local Form I blocks caused or fabricated-speech branches.
topics.reason: The q-w-l speech field supports accountable assertion, narrowed by the local Form I reporting frame.

topics.headline: speech handoff from accusation to reply
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks 34:31-32 as one blame dialogue where the speech root changes role from accusation to answer.
topics.reason: The same-surah speech rows are locally relevant because this occurrence directly answers the prior claim in 34:31.

words.gloss_range: masculine plural relative pronoun identifying the speaking group by its following action

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: nearby reporting verb used as a grammatical or discourse anchor

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) turns the speakers into 'the ones who' before any neutral group name appears. Its relative clause supplies the subject head for {{ar:قَالَ}} ({{tr:qāla}}) and makes self-exalting conduct the handle by which the speakers are known. Because the same relative frame returns for the addressees, the ayah sets up two grammatically comparable parties before the verbs expose their unequal power roles.

topics.headline: conduct-defined subject head
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that arrogance is built into the speakers’ grammatical identity before their denial is heard.
topics.reason: The relative pronoun is the subject head completed by the following predicate, so the speaker label depends on the conduct clause.

topics.headline: plural human relative form
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees a rational group class being named by conduct rather than by an impersonal or singular label.
topics.reason: The plural relative form supports collective accountability without adding a lexical root branch.

topics.headline: paired relative party frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees both sides introduced through matching relative forms, making the dialogue a structured party confrontation.
topics.reason: Words 2 and 5 form matched relative heads while their predicates differentiate active self-elevation from passive weakening.

words.gloss_range: active Form X self-exaltation by the speaking group
words.root_gloss_range: magnitude and greatness extended into claimed superiority; locally self-magnification rather than neutral largeness

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: nearby passive weakening verb used as a contrast anchor

words.prose: {{ar:ٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟}} ({{tr:istakbarū}}) completes the speaker label with an established plural posture of self-exaltation. Form X makes the greatness claimed or performed, so the denial comes from a group already framed as manufacturing rank for itself. The k-b-r magnitude field also lets moral size press toward the closing offender verdict: self-magnified greatness shades toward the language of major wrong, while the local sense remains self-exaltation. Its active voice is set against the passive Form X of {{ar:ٱسْتُضْعِفُوٓا۟}} ({{tr:ustuḍʿifū}}), making power grammar visible before causation is debated. The repeated label across 34:31-33 makes this word the arrogant side’s central reply inside a larger blame exchange.

topics.headline: established arrogant speaker identity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the denial through the prior moral labeling of the speakers, not as neutral testimony.
topics.reason: The perfect plural predicate completes the relative clause that identifies the speakers before their quoted denial.

topics.headline: Form X self-magnification
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that greatness is a claimed social posture, not inherent neutral size.
topics.reason: The k-b-r magnitude field survives as self-exalting rank in Form X; broader greatness fields are narrowed to this local posture.

topics.headline: active-passive power polarity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees unequal power before the argument starts: one side actively claims height while the other is grammatically made weak.
topics.reason: The nearby active and passive Form X verbs create a local contrast in voice and agency that structures the parties.

words.gloss_range: prefixed lām marking the speech recipient after the reporting verb

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: nearby reporting verb used as a grammatical or discourse anchor
fused address phrase spanning the lām and relative-pronoun segment

words.prose: {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}) directs the saying toward the weakened group that had blamed the speakers in 34:31. After {{ar:قَالَ}} ({{tr:qāla}}), the lām is selected as address direction, not possession or benefit, so the reply is face-to-face confrontation rather than commentary about them. Its fusion into {{ar:لِلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:lilladhīna}}) keeps governor and addressee compressed into one immediate address unit before the denial question begins.

topics.headline: directed speech recipient
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the rebuttal is spoken to the blamed group, not merely about them.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the lām-governed relative phrase as the addressee of the reporting verb.

topics.headline: lām narrowed to address direction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader does not mistake the lām for possession, benefit, or purpose; it routes speech to an audience.
topics.reason: The local speech verb selects address direction as the active particle function.

topics.headline: recipient phrase before charge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the weakened audience held in view before the agency question begins.
topics.reason: The recipient phrase is placed before the denial question, keeping the addressees present inside the elite reply.

words.gloss_range: relative-pronoun segment governed by lām, introducing the addressees by a passive identifying clause

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: nearby address-direction particle used as a grammar anchor

words.prose: {{ar:لَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:lladhīna}}) completes the lām-bound address unit and names the audience as a definite group. The pronoun is oblique under {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}), but the following passive clause supplies their identity: they are the ones made weak. In parallel with word 2, the repeated relative form gives the two parties formal symmetry while the predicates create moral and social asymmetry.

topics.headline: governed passive addressee label
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the addressed group is not named neutrally but through the passive condition under which it receives the rebuttal.
topics.reason: The relative segment is governed by the prefixed lām while its predicate identifies the addressees by imposed weakness.

topics.headline: fused relative address unit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees address-governor and group label compressed without either role disappearing.
topics.reason: The surface split still forms the recited address unit, preserving both government and relative identification.

topics.headline: matched relative groups
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the dispute as a paired social scene: self-elevators face those made weak.
topics.reason: The second relative phrase mirrors the first, creating formal parity before the following verbs distinguish agency and vulnerability.

words.gloss_range: passive Form X: were treated as weak or made weak
words.root_gloss_range: weakness, reduction, and related doubling fields; locally imposed weakness, not inherent deficiency or multiplication

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: nearby active self-exaltation verb used as a contrast anchor

words.prose: {{ar:ٱسْتُضْعِفُوٓا۟}} ({{tr:ustuḍʿifū}}) identifies the addressees through passive Form X: they were treated as weak or made weak. The passive withholds the weakener while preserving affectedness, so their vulnerability is grammatically real without becoming an automatic excuse. The weakness root contributes the image of reduced power, almost being folded under force, while local voice and form keep the sense on imposed weakening rather than unrelated multiplication. Its form answers {{ar:ٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟}} ({{tr:istakbarū}}) with the same derived pattern but opposite voice: one group actively claims height, the other receives weakening. Across 34:31-32, the same weakened group moves from speaker to addressee, keeping responsibility inside an acknowledged power imbalance.

topics.headline: passive imposed weakness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that weakness is socially imposed in the grammar, not presented as the group’s natural essence.
topics.reason: QAC marks passive Form X and attachment evidence notes an unexpressed external agent, supporting imposed affectedness without naming the weakener.

topics.headline: weakness root narrowed to reduced power
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels pressure and reduced power in the label, while local voice and form keep the sense away from unrelated multiplication branches.
topics.reason: The ḍ-ʿ-f root range is broad, but the local passive Form X selects imposed weakening as the active branch.

topics.headline: weakened group role handoff
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the same vulnerable group as it shifts from accuser in 34:31 to addressee in 34:32.
topics.reason: Same-root recurrence and the local dialogue boundary preserve identity while changing discourse role.

words.gloss_range: interrogative hamza plus fronted independent first-person plural pronoun

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: nearby obstruction verb used as a valence anchor
nearby adversative particle used as a reversal anchor

words.prose: {{ar:أَنَحْنُ}} ({{tr:ʾanaḥnu}}) compresses the question marker and the independent 'we' into the first word of the quote. The fronted pronoun isolates the disputed agent before {{ar:صَدَدْنَٰكُمْ}} ({{tr:ṣadadnākum}}) names the alleged obstruction, so the question begins with 'we, specifically?' rather than with the act itself. In context it functions as a denial-challenge, not a request for information, and it prepares the later {{ar:بَلْ}} ({{tr:bal}}) reversal from causation to verdict.

topics.headline: fronted agent focus
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that agency is the first contested item in the quote, before obstruction is named.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the independent pronoun as the fronted subject of the obstruction verb, giving contrastive agency focus.

topics.headline: question-plus-pronoun compression
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels interrogation and self-reference arrive as one surface challenge.
topics.reason: The hamza plus independent pronoun compresses question force and first-person focus before the verb appears.

topics.headline: rhetorical denial engine
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the question as a challenge to the prior accusation, setting up a counter-verdict rather than seeking data.
topics.reason: The hamza-question governs the quoted denial and local context selects rhetorical challenge before the adversative verdict.

words.gloss_range: we barred/turned you away, in a rhetorical denial of direct obstruction
words.root_gloss_range: obstruction, barring, and turning aside; locally direct external obstruction is alleged and then denied as sufficient causation

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: nearby separation preposition used as a grammar anchor
nearby guidance noun used as an orientation anchor

words.prose: {{ar:صَدَدْنَٰكُمْ}} ({{tr:ṣadadnākum}}) packs the accusation into one word: first-person plural subject and second-person plural object meet in the alleged act of barring. With {{ar:عَنِ}} ({{tr:ʿani}}) it governs separation from {{ar:ٱلْهُدَىٰ}} ({{tr:al-hudā}}), so the issue is diversion from guidance, not vague influence. The ṣ-d-d root can hold both external obstruction and inward aversion; the attached object selects external blocking for the question, while the later counter-verdict shifts responsibility back toward the addressees. Same-surah echoes, especially 34:43, keep hindrance under dispute rather than settled by this denial.

topics.headline: direct obstruction allegation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the accusation is grammatically concrete: a completed “we barred you” relation with the addressees as object.
topics.reason: The perfect active Form I with object suffix and ʿan-complement supports direct obstruction from guidance as the alleged act.

topics.headline: obstruction and aversion branch narrowed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees why the denial can dispute elite causation without denying that turning-away happened.
topics.reason: The root range includes obstruction and aversion, but the local object suffix selects external obstruction inside the question; later rhetoric redirects blame.

topics.headline: hindrance under dispute across the scene
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks how an implied “if not for you” claim from 34:31 becomes an explicit obstruction verb in 34:32 and returns as accusation in 34:43.
topics.reason: The local ṣ-d-d plus guidance phrase and same-surah references make obstruction a recurring disputed category.

words.gloss_range: preposition marking separation from the governed object of guidance

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: nearby obstruction verb used as a valence anchor
temporal phrase spanning after and the past-time particle

words.prose: {{ar:عَنِ}} ({{tr:ʿani}}) makes guidance the orientation from which the addressees are said to have been diverted. After {{ar:صَدَدْنَٰكُمْ}} ({{tr:ṣadadnākum}}), it is separation, not topic or substitution, and it keeps two relations distinct: the addressees are the object, while guidance is the point left behind. Its kasra before the following hamzat-waṣl keeps separation and guidance moving as one governed unit. Because this phrase comes before {{ar:بَعْدَ إِذْ}} ({{tr:baʿda ʾidh}}), the ayah first names the loss of orientation and then adds its aggravating timing.

topics.headline: separation from guidance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that misguidance is framed spatially and relationally: away from guidance, not merely about guidance.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the ʿan phrase as the governed complement naming what the addressees were turned away from.

topics.headline: ʿan narrowed after obstruction verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader does not flatten the preposition into topic or substitution; the verb selects separation.
topics.reason: The obstruction verb disambiguates the particle as separation from the governed noun.

topics.headline: separation before timing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees a double-distance pattern: away from guidance, then after guidance had arrived.
topics.reason: The separation phrase precedes the temporal phrase, creating a local sequence from lost orientation to post-arrival responsibility.

words.gloss_range: the guidance as a definite, available orientation from which diversion is alleged
words.root_gloss_range: guiding, leading, direction, and delivery; locally recognizable guidance that had come into reach

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: nearby separation preposition used as a grammar anchor
nearby arrival verb used as an access anchor

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْهُدَىٰ}} ({{tr:al-hudā}}) is definite and governed by {{ar:عَنِ}} ({{tr:ʿani}}), so it is the recognizable orientation from which the addressees are said to have been turned. The verbal noun makes guidance a stable thing in the argument: not merely advice, but a path-like orientation made available for movement, something that can be approached, left, and then recovered as the subject of {{ar:جَآءَكُم}} ({{tr:jāʾakum}}). The h-d-y field of leading and delivery remains active because the next clause says guidance had arrived to them; broader gift associations sharpen delivered access but do not replace the selected guidance sense. The phrase therefore presses the moral issue: diversion is alleged from something already made available.

topics.headline: definite guidance as orientation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the dispute is about recognizable guidance, not a vague or hypothetical possibility.
topics.reason: The definite verbal noun governed by ʿan functions as the orientation from which diversion is alleged.

topics.headline: guidance as delivered access
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees guidance as both the orientation left and the reality that had reached the addressees, while local grammar keeps guidance/leading as the selected sense.
topics.reason: Delivery associations in the h-d-y family are relevant because the following arrival verb recovers guidance as subject, but they remain subordinate to the local guidance noun.

topics.headline: guidance after access recurrence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader locates this phrase within a broader pattern where guidance is offered or clarified and then response becomes culpable.
topics.reason: Cross-reference rows support the local mechanism of post-access responsibility without overriding the local grammar.

words.gloss_range: after, as a temporal adverb governing the arrival event-clause
words.root_gloss_range: distance and after-ness; locally temporal sequence that creates moral distance from a non-access excuse

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: event-time phrase spanning the past-time particle and arrival verb
nearby separation preposition used as a grammar anchor

words.prose: {{ar:بَعْدَ}} ({{tr:baʿda}}) turns the final part of the question into timing evidence: the alleged obstruction is measured after the event of guidance’s arrival. It governs {{ar:إِذْ جَآءَكُم}} ({{tr:ʾidh jāʾakum}}), so the phrase is more than a timestamp; it makes prior access the measure of blame. The b-ʿ-d field of distance is narrowed here into sequence, yet its removal and exclusion associations make the timing feel like moral distance from any excuse of non-arrival. Together with {{ar:عَنِ}} ({{tr:ʿani}}), the ayah doubles the loss: away from guidance and after it came.

topics.headline: post-arrival event timing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the question’s burden changes because guidance had already arrived before the alleged blocking.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks baʿda as the adverbial timing relation and ʾidh as its governed temporal complement.

topics.headline: distance root narrowed to moral sequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels after-ness as distance from an excuse, while the local form remains temporal rather than spatial description.
topics.reason: The b-ʿ-d root image of remoteness supports the moral effect, but the local adverbial form selects temporal after-ness.

topics.headline: spatial and temporal separation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the phrase join a proof-timing pattern: response after guidance is different from ignorance before guidance.
topics.reason: Same-surah and cross-reference rows support post-guidance timing, while the local ʿan plus baʿda pairing gives the concrete double-distance effect.

words.gloss_range: past-time particle governed by after, anchoring the arrival event

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: nearby temporal adverb used as a timing anchor
nearby arrival verb used as an access anchor

words.prose: {{ar:إِذْ}} ({{tr:ʾidh}}) is the compact hinge that turns {{ar:بَعْدَ}} ({{tr:baʿda}}) into a full event frame. It is governed by the preceding adverb, not opening an independent scene, so the past arrival functions as evidence inside the rhetorical question. By standing before {{ar:جَآءَكُم}} ({{tr:jāʾakum}}), it lets the prior guidance be recovered as the event subject and makes the remembered arrival the measure of the denial.

topics.headline: governed event anchor
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the arrival clause is subordinate evidence, not a separate narrative scene.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks ʾidh as the temporal complement governed by baʿda, introducing the past arrival clause.

topics.headline: compact temporal hinge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels a small but visible boundary between the timing head and the decisive arrival verb.
topics.reason: The short particle separates the temporal head from the arrival verb and gives the event clause a compact hinge.

topics.headline: evidentiary past circumstance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the past arrival summoned as an argument inside the denial question.
topics.reason: The temporal particle makes the arrival clause a remembered circumstance used as evidence.

words.gloss_range: came to you; guidance arrived to the addressees as prior access
words.root_gloss_range: coming and arrival into presence; locally arrival of guidance into reach, not caused compulsion

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: nearby guidance noun used as an orientation anchor

words.prose: {{ar:جَآءَكُم}} ({{tr:jāʾakum}}) closes the question with the decisive fact of arrival. Its masculine singular form and omitted subject pull the reader back to {{ar:ٱلْهُدَىٰ}} ({{tr:al-hudā}}): guidance is the one that came. The suffix makes the same addressees the recipients of arrival, so they are not only objects of alleged obstruction but people to whom guidance had reached. Form I portrays arrival into access rather than compulsion, and 34:43 later returns to arrival language as another quoted response to what comes.

topics.headline: recovered guidance as arriving subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that guidance is not repeated but grammatically recovered as the actor that reached them.
topics.reason: The masculine singular perfect with no overt subject is syntactically controlled by the prior guidance noun.

topics.headline: personal arrival as access
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees non-access blocked as an excuse because guidance had come into reach for these addressees.
topics.reason: The arrival verb with second-person suffix marks guidance reaching the addressees personally, while Form I avoids causative compulsion.

topics.headline: arrival response recurrence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects the local arrival clause to a pattern where proof or truth comes and the response becomes accountable.
topics.reason: The cited recurrence supports the local point that arrival narrows the excuse after delivery, especially in relation to 34:43.

words.gloss_range: adversative corrective particle redirecting the quote from denied causation to counter-verdict

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: copular verdict phrase spanning the verb and predicate

words.prose: {{ar:بَلْ}} ({{tr:bal}}) snaps the quote from the long denial question into a counter-verdict. It scopes over the whole clause {{ar:كُنتُم مُّجْرِمِينَ}} ({{tr:kuntum mujrimīn}}), not only the copular verb, so the replacement is an offender-identification rather than a small correction. The clipped particle stands outside the following morphology and makes the shift abrupt: from 'did we bar you?' to 'rather, you were offenders.' A second {{ar:بَلْ}} ({{tr:bal}}) in 34:33 answers this one, so the reversal itself becomes part of a continuing blame contest.

topics.headline: adversative counter-verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah does not merely deny a cause; it replaces the causal frame with an identity verdict.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the bal clause as the contrastive counter-accusation, and the particle scopes over the whole copular verdict.

topics.headline: compact reversal particle
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the rhythm tighten exactly where explanation turns into verdict.
topics.reason: The independent short particle begins a new unit after the arrival clause and launches the terse verdict.

topics.headline: competing reversals with 34:33
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees this reversal as provisional within the dialogue because 34:33 opens with a matching counter-reversal.
topics.reason: Concrete same-surah rows point to a second bal in 34:33, making this particle the first turn in a rebuttal-to-rebuttal structure.

words.gloss_range: you were/proved to be, as the copular frame assigning the final predicate
words.root_gloss_range: being, becoming, and established status; locally a perfect copular predicate frame for offender identity

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: nearby offender predicate used as a verdict anchor
nearby adversative particle used as a reversal anchor
nearby obstruction verb used as a valence anchor
nearby arrival verb used as an access anchor

words.prose: {{ar:كُنتُم}} ({{tr:kuntum}}) supplies the copular frame that makes {{ar:مُّجْرِمِينَ}} ({{tr:mujrimīn}}) a predicate identity, not a loose label after {{ar:بَلْ}} ({{tr:bal}}). The perfect form lets the speakers portray culpability as already true when the obstruction claim is discussed. Its second-person plural ending keeps the same addressees chained from object of {{ar:صَدَدْنَٰكُمْ}} ({{tr:ṣadadnākum}}) to recipients of {{ar:جَآءَكُم}} ({{tr:jāʾakum}}) and now subject of the verdict. The k-w-n range of being, becoming, and proved status is narrowed here to an asserted offender-state, a settled position in the culpable category rather than a momentary lapse.

topics.headline: copular identity frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final charge is classification of the addressees, not merely report of one act.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the following participle as predicate of the kāna clause, so the clause assigns identity/status.

topics.headline: being root narrowed to asserted status
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the verdict as established status, while the local copular grammar controls broader being and becoming nuances.
topics.reason: The k-w-n semantic range can cover being, becoming, or proved status; local perfect kāna plus predicate selects asserted culpable status.

topics.headline: second-person verdict chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the same group through object, recipient, and accused subject roles, tightening accountability after access.
topics.reason: The second-person plural morphology continues the same addressee chain from obstruction and arrival into the counter-verdict.

words.gloss_range: offenders, as a plural active participle predicate completing the verdict
words.root_gloss_range: offense, breach, cutting, and incurred liability; locally active offender identity, not an abstract offense noun

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: nearby copular verb used as a predicate-frame anchor

words.prose: {{ar:مُّجْرِمِينَ}} ({{tr:mujrimīn}}) completes the ayah with a plural active-participle predicate. Its accusative predicate role locks the label to the addressed group under {{ar:كُنتُم}} ({{tr:kuntum}}), making culpability collective and grammatical rather than a detached nominative tag. The j-r-m field of offense, breach, cutting, and reaping is narrowed into an active agent-class: the word names offenders, not an abstract offense, and makes culpability feel like an incurred harvest rather than a random label. That final active identity answers the earlier passive label of being made weak and bookends the ayah with rival moral identities: self-exalting speakers at the start and accused offenders at the close.

topics.headline: predicate agent-class verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final word identifies people as culpable agents rather than naming guilt as an abstraction.
topics.reason: QAC marks a masculine plural active participle accusative and attachment marks it as the predicate of the copular clause.

topics.headline: breach and earned consequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels culpability as incurred breach, while local morphology keeps the selected sense on offender identity.
topics.reason: The j-r-m field supports breach and incurred liability, but the local active participle selects the offender-agent branch rather than a crop or abstract noun sense.

topics.headline: passive weakness answered by active culpability
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah hold social vulnerability and moral accusation together without letting either erase the other.
topics.reason: The closing active participle stands against the earlier passive weakness label and frames the utterance as a contest of moral identities.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The opposed forms ٱسْتَكْبَرُوا and ٱسْتُضْعِفُوا frame the question أَنَحْنُ صَدَدْنَٰكُمْ and the countercharge بَلْ كُنتُم مُّجْرِمِينَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The dominant speakers deny that they were the effective barrier. By stressing that guidance had already reached the addressees, then shifting with بَلْ to their prior condition and acquired wrongdoing, they replace a one-cause accusation with a claim of follower agency.

activation_trace.role: Self-exalting grandeur supplies the socially dominant speaking pole and makes its denial interested rather than neutral.
Lack of strength, intensified by the passive form, anchors a condition imposed on the addressed group.
Turning away and causing another to turn supplies the disputed causal act.
Gentle direction toward road and truth is the access from which diversion is denied.
Lateness after a prior event makes sequence, not mere availability, central to the defense.
Coming and obtaining mark guidance as having reached the followers before the alleged obstruction.
Acquisition and causing acquisition make the closing label a claim about enacted agency, not only a fixed status.

changed_reading.before: A dominant group simply kept a powerless group from ever receiving guidance.
changed_reading.after: The ayah stages a disputed causal chain: imposed weakness and elite diversion remain visible, but prior arrival of guidance lets the elite counterclaim that the followers also acquired and enacted culpability.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: قَالَ, the direct address لِلَّذِينَ, the interrogative أَنَحْنُ, and the corrective بَلْ form an adversarial speech act.
baseline_models.mechanism: The utterance negotiates a contested matter and then assumes the power to classify the other side. Its final accusation is therefore a self-interested counterjudgment inside the scene, not automatically the narrator's settled allocation of blame.

activation_trace.role: Negotiation over an affair makes the saying function as a plea in a dispute.
Passing judgment over another supplies the speech's attempt to classify the weaker party.
Rank, leadership, and elevated status give the speakers social power to make their account sound definitive.
Crime and offense provide the accusatory category imposed by that speech.

changed_reading.before: The sentence itself settles which group bears responsibility.
changed_reading.after: The sentence is the hierarchy's defensive adjudication of responsibility, so its agency claim must be heard without mistaking the claimant for the final judge.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding ayah explicitly makes speech circulate between factions and records the weakened party's counterfactual accusation. The focus utterance is thus the elite reply in a reciprocal blame proceeding.

activation_trace.role: Judgment over another anchors the focus reply as an attempted ruling on the accusers.
Repeated sayings become negotiation over the responsibility disputed in the focus.
Returning an answer or speech establishes the focus as a rejoinder rather than an isolated declaration.
Partition into parts supplies mutually accusing factions within one gathered scene.
The criminal label is the elite side's returned accusation.

structural_cues: 34:31 halts the wrongdoers before their Lord, makes each side return speech to the other, and gives the weakened party the first explicit blame claim.
34:32 preserves the same speaker labels but reverses speaker and addressee.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reciprocal speech and the immediately preceding accusation; I infer that 34:32 is a defensive counterplea. A live alternative is that the question denies only exclusive causation, not every kind of influence.

changed_reading.before: The elite issue a standalone denial.
changed_reading.after: The elite answer a concrete charge in a reciprocal proceeding, redirecting blame after the weakened party has named them as a necessary cause.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah separates effective influence from coercive sovereignty. Following occurs despite the influencer's lack of compelling authority, while the weakened party later specifies persistent elite commands. Social pressure and follower enactment can therefore coexist.

activation_trace.role: Causing another to turn is the binary causal claim that the context makes more layered.
Following and tracking supply the followers' enacted participation in an influencer's path.
Power and governing authority, explicitly negated in the source, distinguish influence from irresistible control.
Demand and obligation supply the elite pressure that their focus denial leaves unmentioned.
Night and its darkness provide one half of the continuous temporal enclosure around the commands.
Day opening in light completes the all-cycle persistence of the pressure.
Acquired action preserves follower agency within, rather than outside, the pressure mechanism.

structural_cues: 34:20-21 pairs فَٱتَّبَعُوهُ with وَمَا كَانَ لَهُ عَلَيْهِم مِّن سُلْطَانٍ.
34:33 answers the focus denial with مَكْرُ ٱلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ and إِذْ تَأْمُرُونَنَا.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies following without compelling authority and sustained human commands; I infer that causally potent pressure need not erase the follower's capacity to act. The materially live alternative is that the no-authority statement concerns Iblis and transfers to human elites only by analogy.

changed_reading.before: Either the elite blocked guidance or the followers were responsible.
changed_reading.after: The either-or is exposed as too coarse: elite command can shape and sustain refusal without becoming irresistible sovereignty, while followers remain answerable for the following they enact.

context_deltas.mechanism: A later accusation reuses diversion language against the messenger, alleging that he would turn people from ancestral worship, even as those speakers reject truth when it comes. Obstruction is therefore a contested rhetorical designation, not a self-interpreting act.

activation_trace.role: Direction toward road and truth anchors what the focus speakers allegedly blocked.
The same turning-away image is placed inside an opponent's claim that revelation obstructs inherited worship.
Truth fixed against falsehood identifies what those opponents relabel as sorcery.
Truth's coming repeats the focus sequence in which guidance had come before the dispute over diversion.

structural_cues: 34:43 combines يَصُدَّكُمْ عَمَّا كَانَ يَعْبُدُ ءَابَاؤُكُمْ with لِلْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَاءَهُمْ.
The focus combines صَدَدْنَاكُمْ عَنِ ٱلْهُدَى with بَعْدَ إِذْ جَاءَكُم.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an unusually close recurrence of diversion and arrival under rival descriptions; I infer a deliberate mirror that makes naming the true route part of the conflict. The alternative is a broad thematic recurrence without a direct comment on the focus speakers.

changed_reading.before: The dispute asks only which person physically prevented access.
changed_reading.after: The dispute also concerns who may name a route guidance and name departure from inherited practice obstruction; the elite defense participates in that struggle over descriptions.

context_deltas.mechanism: The nearby sequence partitions accountability by each side's deeds but reserves final separation to divine judgment. The elite reply invokes the first principle when it calls the followers criminals, while speaking as though it also possessed the second.

activation_trace.role: Judgment over another anchors the elite utterance's claim to settle the case.
Crime and offense appear in a first-person responsibility formula that refuses cross-accounting.
Mutual questioning, negated for each side's deeds, separates answerability without denying either side's acts.
Intentional action assigns the addressed side its own behavioral object of accountability.
Gathering dispersed parties supplies the forum in which their separate accounts meet.
Opening an enclosure by judgment supplies the reserved act of deciding between the parties.
Truth fixed to reality is the standard of the reserved judgment.

structural_cues: 34:25 says neither side is questioned about the other's crime or action.
34:26 immediately transfers gathering and truthful judgment to the Lord.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies personal answerability followed by divine adjudication; I infer that 34:32 appropriates the former while rhetorically preempting the latter. A live alternative is that the elite accusation can be factually correct despite its self-serving placement.

changed_reading.before: Calling the followers criminals is either wholly true or wholly evasive.
changed_reading.after: The label borrows a valid principle of nontransferable action but weaponizes it as a premature verdict that suppresses the leaders' own contribution.

context_deltas.mechanism: The post-exchange sequence repeatedly associates rejection with affluent notables who boast of numerical and material abundance. Yet provision is expanded and constricted from beyond them, and true greatness is located elsewhere. Elite self-magnification is thus a resource-backed social performance, not actual sovereignty.

activation_trace.role: Self-exalting greatness anchors the elite identity whose material basis the context exposes.
Greatness and majesty attached to God provide the contrast against human self-enlargement.
Expansive luxury that releases its possessor supplies the recurring social location of rejection.
Rivalrous numerical abundance turns possessions into a claim of superior standing and immunity.
Accumulation of wealth furnishes the material lever of that standing.
Expansion and increase relocate abundance from elite essence to provision that can be extended.
Constriction to a narrow measure makes that same resource status contingent and reversible.

structural_cues: 34:34-35 place affluent rejecters after the elite-follower exchange and give them the boast that greater wealth and children protect them.
34:22 denies false powers even an atom of ownership, while 34:37 denies that wealth and children produce nearness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a recurring affluent rejecting type immediately after the exchange; I infer that it sharpens the social mechanism of ٱسْتَكْبَرُوا. The alternative is typological overlap rather than identity between every arrogant speaker and every affluent notable.

changed_reading.before: Those who acted great are defined only by an inward vice.
changed_reading.after: Their self-greatness is also a social structure backed by wealth, numbers, and prestige, which helps explain how they could pressure others while denying real ownership of those others' choices.

context_deltas.mechanism: Across the surah, an enabled route is followed by requested distance and fragmentation; later divine nearness contrasts with failed reaching from a far place and a final separating barrier. The focus sequence of guidance arriving, then disputed obstruction, occupies the hinge between accessible route and consequence-produced remoteness.

activation_trace.role: Diversion from a route anchors the local obstruction whose wider spatial consequence the context develops.
Gentle indication toward the road makes guidance an accessible orientation.
Arrival marks the moment when that orientation becomes available.
Going and flowing supply the earlier image of a traversable, provisioned route.
Actively making distance supplies a requested separation rather than an originally imposed absence of access.
Tearing into dispersed pieces gives requested remoteness a social and spatial consequence.
Nearness opposed to distance places the source of heard guidance close before the terminal scene.
Failure of apprehension or escape closes the earlier window of reachable response.
Reaching by extension supplies the desired act that remoteness now makes impossible.
Distance opposed to nearness names the terminal position from which belief cannot be reached.
An intervening barrier that separates two things turns the focus's disputed human blockage into a final accomplished separation.

structural_cues: 34:18 offers measured, safe travel; 34:19 requests distance, records self-wrong, and ends in dispersion.
34:50-54 move from a near Lord through no escape and unreachable belief from afar to an actual barrier between people and what they desire.
34:53 adds that prior rejection and conjectural throwing came from a distant place.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated route, nearness, remoteness, reaching, and barrier images; I infer a surah-level topology in which refused access becomes irreversible distance. The alternative is that the Saba route and final seizure are analogical episodes rather than one continuous causal history.

changed_reading.before: The focus concerns only a local argument about who blocked whom in the past.
changed_reading.after: It becomes a hinge in a larger access pattern: a route was supplied and guidance arrived, remoteness was produced through response, and what was once reachable finally stands behind a real barrier.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later exhortation dismantles crowd hierarchy by asking hearers to rise in pairs and alone, then deliberate. Being made weak names a social relation, but does not erase the capacity to step outside collective pressure and think.

activation_trace.role: Lack of strength under an imposed passive form anchors the socially diminished group.
Rising with resolve supplies recoverable action rather than permanent incapacity.
Joining one to one reduces the crowd to a small relational unit where elite consensus can be tested.
The solitary individual supplies deliberation outside leader-follower mass alignment.
The heart's repeated turning over a matter supplies the cognitive act by which inherited pressure can be reexamined.

structural_cues: 34:46 follows the collective blame and affluent-rejection scenes with a command to stand for God in pairs and individually, then think.
The focus calls the subordinate group made weak rather than depicting them as constitutionally without agency.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a later pair-and-solitary deliberative procedure; I infer that it answers the mechanism of group capture exposed around the focus. The alternative is a general apologetic exhortation not specifically aimed at elite-follower dependence.

changed_reading.before: Imposed weakness and personal responsibility are incompatible descriptions.
changed_reading.after: They describe different levels: hierarchy can diminish people, while pairwise and solitary reflection shows a remaining capacity to recover judgment and therefore a basis for answerability.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because one root inventory moves from lack of strength in the focus to increase by a like amount in 34:37. It remains valid as a same-root polarity that unsettles the finality of the social label, but downstream prose must not translate ٱسْتُضْعِفُوا as multiplication or claim that the doubled reward is promised specifically to this group.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ٱسْتُضْعِفُوا carries the ض ع ف root whose other packet branch is activated by جَزَاءُ ٱلضِّعْفِ.

activation_trace.role: Weakness contrary to strength supplies the group's imposed present diminishment.
Increase by a matching amount supplies a latent reversal from social reduction to multiplied recompense.

changed_reading.before: The root label fixes the addressed group entirely within deficit.
changed_reading.after: The same root field carries a contained reversal: imposed diminishment is not semantically terminal, because the surah later activates multiplication in recompense.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain model is surprising because it combines remote material branches: a road to water, a mountain barrier, and pooled water around a fortification. It remains anchored in صَدَدْنَاكُمْ, ٱلْهُدَى, and جَاءَكُمْ as an access analogy, but downstream prose must label it material imagery and never substitute those remote senses for the ayah's ordinary syntax.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus joins diversion, path-guidance, and arrival in one causal question.

activation_trace.role: A road leading to water supplies the material image of access to a sustaining resource.
A mountain acting as a barrier supplies the infrastructure of intercepted access.
Guidance as direction to a road keeps the material analogy attached to the focus construction.
Water gathered in a depression or around a fortification supplies the branch-distant image of a resource present yet spatially controlled.

changed_reading.before: Obstruction is an abstract act of persuasion.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the accusation pictures guidance as access infrastructure: a sustaining route has arrived, and the dispute is whether elites installed the barrier controlling approach to it.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the non-dominant ق ل ل mapping supplied for the focus root ق و ل. It remains anchored as an inspectable split-root activation that describes what the utterance does rhetorically, but downstream prose must never gloss قَالَ as becoming little or present the image as etymology.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: قَالَ introduces a defense that narrows the speakers' acknowledged causal share.

activation_trace.role: Scantness and smallness supply the exploratory image of speech shrinking admitted responsibility.
Judgment over another supplies the complementary move: the speakers minimize their share by enlarging the other's blame.

changed_reading.before: The elite utterance only reports their view of causation.
changed_reading.after: As a contained rhetorical activation, the saying performs minimization: it shrinks the speakers' causal share while issuing a judgment that expands the followers' blame.

strongest_changes: The adjacent returned-speech scene makes 34:32 an elite counterplea rather than a narratorial settlement.
Following without coercive authority, followed by explicit commands across night and day, produces layered causation in which elite influence and follower accountability coexist.
The mirrored obstruction claim in 34:43 and the final near-far-barrier sequence turn diversion into both a struggle over naming the true route and a trajectory toward irreversible failed access.
The affluent-rejecter sequence gives self-magnification a material social mechanism while denying it real sovereignty.
summary.what_was_special: The packet preserved opposed mechanisms instead of forcing a verdict: imposed weakness versus recoverable agency, social pressure versus coercion, personal answerability versus premature elite judgment, and an accessible route that becomes remoteness. Same-root and split-root outliers also exposed multiplication inside ض ع ف and rhetorical minimization through the non-dominant ق ل ل mapping.
remaining_uncertainties: The transfer from Iblis's lack of سلطان to human elite influence is a strong analogy but not an explicit identity.
The affluent rejecters likely sharpen the type ٱسْتَكْبَرُوا, but the packet does not require every member of the two groups to be identical.
The route-to-water, pooled-water, multiplication, and split-root minimization images require explicit qualification to avoid lexical overreach.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **The leaders redefine blockage as the followers’ own incurred cut.** `ص د د/B005` is a blocking mountain, `ه د ي/B002` intended direction, `ج ي ء/B001` arrival, and `ج ر م/B001` cutting off or harvesting. Their question places alleged obstruction after guidance had arrived; their answer assigns criminality to the addressed group. Blockage supplies an external barrier, arrival supplies prior access, and cutting-off recasts failure as self-incurred. The packet gives the rival causal claims; I do not resolve them. The ayah preserves two readings: coercive obstruction and culpable self-severance, exposing the dispute over where the causal arrow belongs.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 34:33 corrected the leaders’ self-severance account by supplying continuous command as an external pressure; the packet preserves both causal levels rather than allowing either to cancel the other.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Obstruction narrowed to a literal barrier.** `ص د د B001` supplies turning away, while `ص د د B005` supplies a blocking mountain. The powerful ask whether they themselves blocked guidance after it arrived; 34:33 answers with continuous night-and-day command to disbelieve. The branches let their question reduce influence to a hard obstacle while omitting repeated social redirection. The packet supplies denial and later command mechanism; I infer that the leaders exploit the narrower causal model. The question reads as evasive reframing: no physical wall, therefore no responsibility for sustained turning.

2. **Responsibility reassigned as individual earnings.** `ج ر م B003` supplies earning and causing to incur, and `ج ر م B004` guilt or offense. `بَلْ` moves the whole causal burden onto the followers' status as criminals, after 34:31 had them blame leaders. The branches assign `مُّجْرِمِينَ` the role of self-incurred liability. The packet supplies the competing attributions; I infer that the reply uses individual earning to erase social contribution. The ayah reads as a dispute over levels of causality, not a simple denial of agency.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 34:33 explicitly names `تَأْمُرُونَنَآ`, correcting the leaders' claim that they did not block guidance. It does not erase the followers' acts, but makes persistent command a visible intermediate cause between arrival and turning away.

baseline.text: Büyüklük taslayanlar güçsüz bırakılanlara, ‘Doğru yol size geldikten sonra sizi ondan biz mi alıkoyduk? Hayır, siz suç işleyenlerdiniz’ derler.

findings.text: Büyüklük taslayanlar engellemeyi sert ve görünür bir duvara indirger; böylece sürekli toplumsal yönlendirmeyi, fiziksel bir set kurmadıkları gerekçesiyle nedensellik hesabından çıkarmaya çalışırlar.
Suçlu nitelemesi, bireysel kazanılmış sorumluluğu öne çıkarırken toplumsal baskının katkısını silmek için bütün yükü izleyenlere aktaran bir cevap işlevi görür.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Arrogant leaders explicitly reject what the others believed, closely paralleling the social hierarchy behind the focus dialogue.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Disbelief in the Hereafter and adorned deeds produce wandering, providing a related account of misdirected culpability.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It identifies a discernible way of the criminals, supporting the focus's attribution of acquired criminal responsibility.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P3: Command-Chain Blame Becomes Embodied Restraint
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: At the final standing, diffuse influence is reconstructed as a chain of obstruction, scheduled plotting, command, compliance, regret, and recompense, ending in bodily restraint.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: A social command structure is translated step by step into a restraint structure; what passed down as instruction returns upward as accusation and finally closes around the neck.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Detained Dialogue Reconstructs Delegated Agency
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Parties are stopped before the Lord and return speech to one another as the weakened accuse the status-bearing arrogant of obstruction.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: detention at a standing place (`quranic:root_001676:B001/m01`), returned speech (`quranic:root_000544:B005/m01`), imposed weakness (`quranic:root_000909:B001/m01`), elevated social rank (`quranic:root_001281:B005/m01`), arrogance against truth (`quranic:root_001281:B006/m01`), obstruction (`quranic:root_000848:B001/m01`), guidance toward a route (`quranic:root_001583:B001/m01`), culpable offense (`quranic:root_000239:B004/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Stoppage reverses the former hierarchy by making speech travel back toward its claimed source. Yet the reply refuses simple transfer of agency, forcing the dialogue to expose both pressure and participation.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bu dalı sesle ortaya çıkarılan söz ve harflerden kurulu sözlü ifade olarak verir. Geçici çerçeve aynı çekirdeği taşıyor; dil organı, hükümdar unvanı ve mecazi yan kullanımlar bu dalın dışında kalır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal çıplak söz söyleme ve söylenmiş söz çekirdeğidir; organ, unvan, söylenti ve mecazlar ayrı dallardır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam bare olduğu için tanım çıplak söyleme ve sözlü ifade anlamıyla sınırlıdır.

concept_map.definition: Bir düşünceyi veya sözü sesli biçimde dışa vurma ve böyle dışa vurulmuş harfli sözlü ifade anlamıdır.

facets.statement: Çekirdek işlem, sözü sesli olarak dışa çıkarmaktır.
Söylenen şey tek söz, cümle, şiir veya konuşma ölçeğinde olabilir.
Ad biçimleri aynı söylenmiş söz alanında toplanır.

branches.source_phrase_ar: القل القليل؛ رماه الله بالقل والذل أي بالقلة والذلة (jamhara)؛ شيء قليل وجمعه قلل؛ قل الشيء يقل قلة؛ قلله في عينه؛ أقل افتقر؛ استقله عده قليلا (sihah)؛ قل الشيء يقل قلة فهو قليل وقلال؛ القل من الرجال الخسيس الدنيء؛ قليلة ولا كثيرة؛ قليلا ما يؤمنون؛ قاللت لفلان؛ تقاللت ما أعطاني (tahdhib)؛ القلة والكثرة يستعملان في الأعداد؛ يكنى بالقلة عن الذلة؛ يكنى بها تارة عن العزة؛ قليل يعبر به عن النفي (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir şeyin en üstünü veya başını çekirdek anlam olarak verir; dağın yuvarlak üst bölümü, insan başı ve kılıcın başındaki topuz bu çekirdeğin açık uzmanlaşmalarıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol uzamsal başı ve en üst parçayı bildirir; sayısal azlık ya da büyük kap anlamını içermez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel baş ve en üst bölüm anlamı ile dağ tepesi, insan başı ve kılıç topuzu gibi yapıya bağlı uzmanlaşmalar ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin başını veya en üst bölümünü bildirir. Dağın üstteki yuvarlak parçası, insan başı ve kılıcın sap ucundaki topuz bu uzamsal çekirdeğin özel gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Bir nesnenin veya oluşumun başı ya da en üstte bulunan bölümüdür.
Dağın en üstünde yer alan, kimi tanımda yuvarlak biçimli bölümünü adlandırır.
İnsan başı ile kılıcın sap ucundaki başlık veya topuz da aynı üst ve baş kavramıyla adlandırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar bir şeyin başı ve en üst bölümü üzerinde birleşir; dağ tepesi temel örnektir, insan başı ile kılıç topuzu da aynı biçimsel ve uzamsal çizgide yer alır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir nesnenin ya da doğal oluşumun en üst bölümünü ve başını kapsayan genel karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Baş olma ile uzamsal olarak en üstte bulunma çekirdeğini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Dağın en üst ve kimi zaman yuvarlak bölümünün adlandırıldığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Dağa özgü en üst bölüm uzmanlaşmasını doğrudan korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İnsan başının veya başka bir şeyin baş sayılan üst bölümünün kastedildiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Üst bölümün baş olarak kavranmasını kısa ve doğal biçimde verir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kılıcın sap ucunda bulunan başlık ya da topuz parçası anlatılırken kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kılıca özgü baş veya üst parça uzmanlaşmasını korur.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Baş ve üst bölüm çekirdekleri yakındır; bu kol tepe ve topuz biçimini öne çıkarırken komşu kol başı daha geniş varlık ve kullanım alanlarında işler.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kol somut baş ve üst parça sınırında kalır; komşu kol fiziksel doruktan toplumsal yüceliğe uzanan daha geniş bir yükseklik alanı kurar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu kol başı, tepeyi ve en üstte bulunan parçayı bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kol sayı, miktar veya ölçü bakımından azlığı bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Aynı kökün sesçe yakın iki ayrı anlam kolu olmaları dışında ortak çekirdekleri yoktur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu anlam uzamsal bir üst bölüm adıdır; komşu anlam ise çokluğun karşıtı olan nicelik durumudur.

branches.what_is_ar: قُلَّة الجبل وأعلى كل شيء، ورأس الإنسان، وقبيعة السيف
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس القلة بمعنى الصغر أو العدد القليل، وليس إناء القُلَّة
branches.source_phrase_ar: القلة قلة الجبل وهي القطعة تستدير في أعلاه وهي القنة (jamhara)؛ القلة أعلى الجبل؛ قلة كل شيء أعلاه؛ رأس الإنسان قلة (sihah)؛ قلة كل شيء رأسه؛ قلة الجبل أعلاه؛ قبيعة السيف قلته؛ سيف مقلل (tahdhib)؛ قلة الجبل شعفه (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi büyük bir küp veya iri kap anlamında birleşir; iki kaplık ölçü ve belirli bir bölgeyle anılan iri küpler de aynı kap anlamını somutlaştırır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol büyük bir kap türünü ve onun ölçü değerini kapsar; nicelik azlığı veya dağ tepesi anlamını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Büyük küp anlamı çekirdektir; belirli bir bölgeye bağlanan kap adı ile iki kaplık ölçü yalnızca kendi yapılardaki uzmanlaşmalardır.

concept_map.definition: Büyük bir küpü veya küpe benzeyen iri kabı bildirir. Belirli bir bölgenin iri küpleri ve iki böyle kabın aldığı miktar bu kap anlamına bağlı özel kullanımlardır.

facets.statement: Küpe benzeyen, özellikle sıvı taşımaya veya saklamaya elverişli büyük bir kaptır.
Belirli bir bölgeyle anılan iri küpler veya büyük toprak kaplar bu adın tanınmış bir türünü oluşturur.
İki büyük kap, bu iki kabın kendisini veya onların aldığı sıvı miktarını bildiren bir ölçü değeri kazanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar iri bir küp veya büyük kap üzerinde birleşir; tanınmış bölgesel kaplar büyüklüğü örnekler, iki kaplık kullanım ise nesne adını kapasite ölçüsüne taşır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Küpe benzeyen iri kabı adlandıran temel ve en doğal Türkçe karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Kabın küp türünde ve olağandan büyük oluşunu birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kabın özellikle su alması ve büyük kapasitesi öne çıkarıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Büyük kabı ve kaynakta belirtilen su taşıma kapasitesini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İki kabın kendisinden çok onların aldığı sıvı miktarı ölçü olarak kastedildiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: İki büyük kabın kapasitesine dayanan ölçü kullanımını tam olarak korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: iki büyük küp veya bunların aldığı miktar

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kol bir şeyin başını, tepesini veya en üst bölümünü bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Aynı kökün sesçe yakın iki ayrı anlam kolu olmaları dışında ortak çekirdekleri yoktur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Biri hacimli bir kap ve onun ölçüsüdür; diğeri bir varlığın uzamsal olarak en üstteki parçasıdır.

branches.source_phrase_ar: القلة التي جاءت في الحديث مثل قلال هجر هي جرار عظام (jamhara)؛ القلة إناء للعرب كالجرة الكبيرة؛ قلال هجر شبيهة بالحباب (sihah)؛ قلتين يعني هذه الحباب العظام واحدتها قلة؛ قلال هجر؛ القلة منها تأخذ مزادة من الماء (tahdhib)؛ القلة ما أقله الإنسان من جرة وحب (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yükü taşıma veya taşıyabilme ile öznenin yükselip harekete geçmesini aynı kolda açıkça toplar; kuşun uçuşa kalkması, göğün yükselmesi ve yolcuların yüklenip ayrılması ayrı katılımcı gerçekleşmeleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Taşıma, yükselme ve yüklenerek yola koyulma bu kolun sınırıdır; salt sayısal azlık bu anlamlara katılmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yük taşıma ile yükselme çekirdek çizgileri ayrılır; ağır bulut taşıma, uçuşa kalkma ve yolcuların ayrılması yalnızca kendi özne ve yapılarında geçerlidir.

concept_map.definition: Bir yükü kaldırıp taşıyabilmeyi veya üstlenmeyi ve bir öznenin yükselerek harekete geçmesini bildirir. İkinci çizgi kuşun uçuşa kalkmasını, göğün yükselmesini ve yolcuların yüklenip yola koyulmasını kapsar.

facets.statement: Bir nesneyi kaldıracak gücü bulmak, onu taşımak veya yük olarak üstlenmektir.
Bir öznenin aşağıdaki konumundan yükselmesi veya kuş gibi harekete ve uçuşa başlamasıdır.
Yolcuların yüklerini alıp bulundukları yerden ayrılarak yolculuğa başlamasıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar bir yükü kaldırıp taşıma ile yukarı kalkarak harekete geçme çizgilerini bir araya getirir; kuş, gök, bulut ve yolcu örnekleri katılımcıya göre bu iki çizgiyi somutlaştırır.

concept_gloss.text: yük kaldırma, yükselme ve yola koyulma

error_profile.preserves: Yük üstlenme, yükselme ve yolculuk için harekete geçme bileşenlerini birlikte korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi kişiyi korku veya öfke yüzünden tutan titreme ve silkinişi açıkça tanımlar; genel hareket kararsızlığı değil, duygusal tetikleyicisi bulunan bedensel bir sarsıntı söz konusudur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol insanda korku veya öfkeyle beliren titremeyle sınırlıdır; nesnelerin genel sallanma ve yerinde duramama hali ayrı koldadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Duygudan doğan titreme temel addır; kişiyi titremenin tutması ve öfkeden titrer hale gelmesi yalnızca ilgili yapılara bağlı anlatımlardır.

concept_map.definition: Bir insanın korku veya öfke yüzünden titremesi, ürpermesi ya da bedensel olarak silkelenmesidir. Durum, kişiyi bir titreme nöbetinin tutması veya öfkenin titremeyle dışa vurulması biçiminde anlatılabilir.

facets.statement: İnsan bedeninde beliren titreme, ürperti veya istemsiz silkiniş halidir.
Titremenin belirleyici nedeni korku ya da öfkedir.
Belirli yapılarda titremenin kişiyi tutması veya kişinin öfkeden titrer hale gelmesi anlatılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar insandaki titreme ve silkinişte birleşir; korku ile öfke başlıca nedenlerdir ve durum hem kişiyi tutan bir nöbet hem öfkenin bedensel belirtisi olarak anlatılır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Duygusal nedeni ve bedensel titremeyi birlikte taşıyan bütün kol için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Korku veya öfke koşulunu ve bunun doğurduğu bedensel titremeyi birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Korkunun yol açtığı kısa ve istemsiz bedensel titreme bağlamında kullanılır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Öfkenin bedensel titreme halinde dışa vurulduğu kişi bağlamlarına özgüdür.

error_profile.preserves: Öfke nedenini ve onunla birlikte ortaya çıkan titremeyi korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir şeyi hareket ettirip sallandırma, nesnenin bulunduğu yerde kararlı duramaması ve hareketin çıkardığı sesi birlikte verir; bunlar tek bir fiziksel hareket olayının neden, sonuç ve işitsel yönleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol genel fiziksel oynama, kararsızlık ve hareket sesiyle ilgilidir; korku veya öfkeden doğan insana özgü titreme değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım çıplak kolun hareket ettirme, sallanma, yerinde duramama ve hareket sesi anlamlarını kapsar; özel bir yapının anlamı genelleştirilmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi hareket ettirerek yerinden oynatmayı ve onun kararsızca sallanıp bulunduğu yerde duramamasını bildirir; bu hareketin çıkardığı ses de aynı olayın işitsel yönüdür.

facets.statement: Bir nesneyi hareket ettirip onun yerinden oynamasına ve sarsılmasına neden olmaktır.
Nesnenin bulunduğu yerde sabit kalmayıp sallanması, oynaması veya düzensiz hareket etmesidir.
Sallanma ve yer değiştirme sırasında çıkan ses, hareket olayının işitsel belirtisi olarak adlandırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar dışarıdan hareket ettirme ile nesnenin kararsızca sallanıp yerinde duramaması üzerinde birleşir; hareketin sesi bu fiziksel olayın ayrılmaz işitsel belirtisi olarak eklenir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Neden olunan hareketi ve nesnenin ortaya çıkan kararsız sallanmasını birlikte kapsayan temel karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Hareket ettirme nedenini ve sabit kalamayan nesnenin sallanma sonucunu birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin bir nesneyi hareket ettirerek onun oynamasına ve sarsılmasına neden olduğu bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Dışarıdan uygulanan hareketi ve nesnenin sarsılması sonucunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir nesnenin gevşeklik veya kararsızlık nedeniyle bulunduğu yerde sabit kalmadığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Sabit kalamama ile düzensiz sallanma durumunu birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sallanan veya oynayan nesnenin çıkardığı sesin adlandırıldığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Sesin genel bir ses değil, hareketten doğan işitsel belirti oluşunu korur.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki kol da bir nesneyi hareket ettirip onun sallanmasına veya sarsılmasına neden olmayı anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Fiziksel sarsılma alanı yakındır; bu kol hareket ettirme, sabit kalamama ve hareket sesini kurarken komşu kol farklı varlıklardaki şiddetli sarsıntıyı öne çıkarır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu kolda ses, nesnenin kararsız hareketi ve sallanmasının sonucu olarak ortaya çıkar.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki kol da bir nesnenin hareketi sırasında ortaya çıkan işitilebilir sesi içerebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kolun çekirdeği fiziksel kararsızlık ve sallanmadır, ses ikincildir; komşu kolda ses ve çınlama daha bağımsız bir anlam alanı oluşturur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu kol nesnenin oynatılması, yerinde duramaması ve hareket sesiyle ilgilidir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kolda nesne ve fiziksel kararsızlık kurucudur; komşu kolda insan bedeni ile korku veya öfke nedeni kurucudur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, küçüklüğün karşıtı olan genel büyüklüğü; ölçü, miktar, sayı veya göreli derecede büyük olma üzerinden açıkça kurar. Geçici çerçeve bu çekirdeği yaşlılık, kibir ya da bir işin ana bölümü gibi komşu anlamlardan doğru biçimde ayırır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal genel büyüklüğü anlatır; yaş, ahlaki üstünlük, kibir ve bir bütünün en büyük payı ayrı dallardadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın büyüklük alanıyla sınırlıdır ve yalnız belirli bir kalıba bağlı olan anlamları içine almaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin ölçü, miktar, sayı ya da göreli derecede küçüğün karşıtı olacak ölçüde büyük olmasıdır.

facets.statement: Bir varlık veya değerin küçüğe göre daha büyük ölçü ya da derece taşıması temel anlamdır.
Büyüklük somut hacim yanında miktar, sayı ve genel konum bakımından da kurulabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar ortak biçimde bu alanı küçüklüğün karşıtı sayar ve büyüklüğü nesnenin ölçüsüne, miktarına, sayısına veya göreli derecesine uygular.

concept_gloss.applicability: Ölçü, miktar, sayı veya genel derece bakımından küçüğün karşıtı kastedildiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Küçüğe göre büyük olma çekirdeğini ve farklı ölçüm alanlarına uygulanabilmesini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bağlam hangi ölçü veya derece ekseninin söz konusu olduğunu zaten gösterdiğinde doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Bağlam içinde küçüğün karşıtı olan genel büyüklüğü eksiksiz biçimde taşır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal aynı eksenin büyük olan kutbunu bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal aynı eksenin küçük olan kutbunu bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da ölçü, sayı, yaş veya konum gibi karşılaştırılabilir bir derece ekseninde çalışır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal büyüklüğü, komşu dal ise küçüklüğü bildirir; aynı göreli ölçeğin karşıt kutuplarıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal sayı, miktar ve genel dereceyi de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal özellikle beden veya bir işteki irilik ve hacimliliği öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da somut bir şeyin büyük ve hacimli oluşunu anlatabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak daha genel bir karşılaştırmalı büyüklük alanıdır; komşu ise özellikle iri yapı ve hacimli oluş üzerinde yoğunlaşır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; karşıt küçüklük ile kısmen örtüşen irilik, sınırı en açık gösteren iki karşılaştırma olarak seçildi.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir şeyin en büyük veya ana bölümünü, ayrıca bir olayın başlıca yükünü üstlenen kişiye uzanan kullanımı destekler. Geçici çerçeve bunu salt hacim büyüklüğünden ve yaşlılıktan doğru biçimde ayırır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam bir bütünün ana payı veya bir işin başlıca yüküdür; genel büyüklük tek başına bu dalı karşılamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın ad biçimindeki ana pay anlamı ile belirli söz öbeklerinde görülen işin önemli bölümü anlamı ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir işin ya da bütünün en büyük ve başlıca bölümü, bundan hareketle de o işin başlıca yükü veya sorumluluğudur.

facets.statement: Bir bütünün en büyük, ana veya belirleyici bölümü temel anlamdır.
Ana bölüm fikri, bir olayın başlıca yükünü üstlenme veya ondan en büyük payı taşıma anlamına uzanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bir şeyin ana ve en büyük bölümünde birleşir; toplu aktarım ayrıca bir olayın başlıca yükünü üstlenen kişiye yapılan göndermeyi de içerir.

concept_gloss.text: bir işin ana payı ve başlıca yükü

error_profile.preserves: Ana bölüm ile bu bölümü üstlenmeye bağlı yük ve sorumluluk ilişkisini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Söz konusu olan bir olayın veya meselenin nicelikçe ya da önemce ana payıysa kullanılır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin olayın en büyük yükünü üstlenmesi veya olaydan başlıca sorumlu olması kastedildiğinde kullanılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir şeyi zihinde büyük saymayı, büyük görmeyi ve bundan doğan hayreti açıkça bildirir. Geçici çerçevenin hayranlık yönü ancak bu zihinsel büyütme ve şaşırma sınırında anlaşılmalıdır; ayrı bir bedensel yorum bu dala alınmaz.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek, bir şeyi gözünde büyütüp büyük saymaktır; sırf sevinme, güzel bulma veya korkma tek başına yeterli değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Anlam, nesne alan yapılar ve tanıklanmış özel çekimli kullanım üzerinden verilir; genel büyüklük anlamıyla birleştirilmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi veya kişiyi zihninde büyük ve önemli saymak, onu gözünde büyütmek ve bunun etkisiyle hayrete düşmektir.

facets.statement: Bir şeyi zihinde büyük görmek ve önemini olduğundan ya da sıradan düzeyden yüksek değerlendirmek çekirdektir.
Bu zihinsel büyütmeye, görülen şey karşısında hayret etme tepkisi eşlik edebilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bir şeyi büyük sayma ve gözünde büyütme anlamında birleşir; bazı aktarımlar bunun doğurduğu hayreti de açıkça belirtir.

error_profile.preserves: Nesneyi zihinde büyük görme ve ona yüksek önem verme çekirdeğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Büyük görmenin doğrudan bir hayret tepkisi doğurduğu bağlamlarda açıklayıcı karşılıktır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak nesneyi büyük sayma ve şaşırma değerlendirmesini içerir.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da olumlu veya çarpıcı bir şey karşısındaki etkilenmeyi anlatabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Beğeni ve sevinç nesneyi büyük saymayı gerektirmez; odak dalın kurucu işlemi ise onu zihinde büyütmektir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi insan ve hayvanlarda ileri yaşı, ayrıca ok ve kılıç ağzı gibi eski nesnelerde zamanla yerleşen eskiliği birlikte destekler. Geçici çerçeve yaşlanma ile nesne eskiliğini ayırmadan aynı zaman ekseninde, fakat başkanlık ve kibirden ayrı tutar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: İnsan ve hayvanda yaşlanma, eski nesnede köhneme anlatılır; genel büyüklük veya makam yüksekliği anlatılmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: İnsan ve hayvanın yaşlanmasını bildiren kullanım ile nesnenin eskiliğini bildiren özel biçim aynı dalda ayrı yüzler olarak korunur.

branches.source_phrase_ar: ومن الباب الكبر وهو الهرم (maqayis)؛ الكبرة السن يقال علته كبرة (ayn)؛ بلغ فلان الكبر في السن (jamhara)؛ الكبر في السن وقد كبر الرجل أي أسن (sihah)؛ الكبر مصدر الكبير في السن من الناس والدواب (tahdhib)؛ يقال فلان كبير أي مسن (mufradat)؛ السهم والنصل العتيق الذي أفسده الوسخ قد علته كبرة (ayn)؛ للسيف والنصل العتيق الذي قدم علته كبرة (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi şeref yüksekliğini, kuşaktan kuşağa aktarılan itibarı ve topluluk içindeki başkanlık ya da bilgi üstünlüğünü birlikte verir. Geçici çerçeve bu toplumsal yüksekliği yaş büyüklüğünden ve doğum sırasından doğru biçimde ayırır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Buradaki büyüklük toplumsal saygınlık, önderlik veya bilgi konumudur; salt yaş ve beden büyüklüğü değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Önder ve saygın kişi bildiren biçimler ile kuşaklar arası soyluluğu anlatan kalıp ayrı yüzler olarak tanımlanır.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişinin şeref, saygınlık, bilgi veya önderlik bakımından topluluk içinde yüksek konumda bulunması; bu konumun kuşaktan kuşağa aktarılabilmesidir.

facets.statement: Şeref ve toplumsal konum bakımından yüksek ve saygın olma çekirdektir.
Yüksek konum, topluluğun başı, öğreticisi veya en bilgili kişisi olma biçiminde gerçekleşebilir.
Şeref ve itibarın büyük ve saygın atalardan sonraki kuşaklara aktarılması da bu alandadır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kaynak aktarımı şeref yüksekliği, önderlik ve bilgide üstün konumu bir araya getirir; ayrıca itibarın saygın atalardan kuşaklara aktarılmasını belirtir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Şerefli soy, topluluk başkanlığı, öğreticilik veya bilgi üstünlüğüyle oluşan yüksek konum kastedildiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Şeref, önderlik, bilgi üstünlüğü ve kuşaklar arası itibar bileşenlerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin topluluk içindeki saygın, bilgili veya yönetici konumu öne çıktığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Toplumsal saygınlık ile önderlik konumunu birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Şeref ve itibarın saygın atalardan sonraki kuşaklara geçtiği anlatımlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Miras alınan toplumsal itibarın kuşaklar boyunca sürmesini korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: kuşaktan kuşağa soylu ve saygın biçimde

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak önderlik, öğreticilik ve atalardan aktarılan itibarı da içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu daha genel biçimde değer ve şeref yüksekliğini bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal kişinin şeref ve toplumsal değer bakımından yüksek konumunu anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu genel şeref yüksekliğidir; odak bu yüksekliği topluluk içi önderlik ve kuşaktan kuşağa aktarılan itibara bağlar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak şerefli soy ve bilgide üstünlüğü başkanlık dışında da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu topluluk adına duran başkanlık ve temsil görevini özellikle öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal topluluğun başı veya önderi olan saygın kişiyi gösterebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşuda temsil ve başkanlık kurucudur; odakta ise bu, şeref ve bilgi yüksekliğinin olası gerçekleşmelerinden biridir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; genel şeref yüksekliği ile işlevsel başkanlık, odak dalın saygınlık ve önderlik sınırlarını en iyi açan iki komşudur.
branches.what_is_ar: العلو في الشرف أو المنزلة أو الرئاسة أو التعليم أو السيادة والمجد الموروث
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس ترتيب الولادة المختلف فيه ولا كبر السن وحده

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi büyüklük ve ululuk yanında insanın kendini üstün görmesiyle ortaya çıkan böbürlenmeyi açıkça destekler. Geçici çerçevenin Tanrı'ya özgü hak edilmiş ululuk yönü ayrı söz birimi kanıtında bulunur, fakat yetkili dal iddiasında açıkça kurulmadığı için dal tanımının çekirdeğine alınmamıştır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, ululuk ve kendini üstün görme alanındadır; özel inançsal niteleme yalnız ilgili söz biriminin karşılığında korunur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın ululuk ve üstünlük taslama alanını verir; başka dallardaki büyüklük, yaş veya başkanlık anlamlarını içeri almaz.

concept_map.definition: Ululuk ve üstünlük niteliği ya da kişinin kendisini başkalarından üstün görerek büyüklük taslaması ve boyun eğmemesidir.

facets.statement: Ululuk, üstünlük ve başkalarından yukarıda olma düşüncesi anlamın temel eksenidir.
İnsanda bu eksen, kendini beğenme, başkalarından üstün sayma ve büyüklük taslama biçiminde gerçekleşir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar ululuk ve büyüklük anlamında birleşir; insan davranışında bunun kendini beğenme, üstün sayma ve büyüklük taslama biçimini aldığını belirtir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Ululuk niteliği veya insanın kendisini başkalarından üstün sayarak büyüklük taslaması kastedildiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Genel ululuk eksenini ve insandaki kendini üstün görme gerçekleşmesini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir insanın kendisini üstün görüp başkalarına karşı böbürlendiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kendini üstün sayma ve bunu davranışla gösterme yönünü korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Ahlaki olarak olumlu ya da olumsuz insan davranışı belirtilmeden salt yücelik niteliği kastedildiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Üstün ve yüce olma biçimindeki genel büyüklük eksenini korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: büyüklük taslama ve kendini üstün görme
